title: Diwali Morning Concert In Bay Area, Ca
description: Experience the Magic of Diwali with the Morning Concert in Bay Area
long_description:
Experience the Magic of Diwali with the Morning Concert in Bay Area
Mark your calendars for November 14th, 2026, as Para Share Entertainments proudly presents the Diwali Morning Concert in Bay Area, CA. Celebrate the festival of lights with an enchanting fusion of Hindi, Bengali and English melodies, performed live in concert by the talented Shounak Abhisheki. Immerse yourself in an unforgettable morning of singing and music, complemented by a delightful selection of food and drink.
Shounak Abhisheki: The Voice of Versatility
Meet Shounak Abhisheki, an Indian vocalist and composer acclaimed for his renditions of classical, semi-classical, and devotional music. With his melodic prowess and creative compositions, Shounak has captivated audiences all over the world. This Diwali, experience a sublime musical journey as Shounak lights up the stage with his soulful performances that resonate with the spirit of the festival.
Discover the Vibrancy of San Jose at Our Concert Venue
The event venue details are to be announced shortly. Rest assured, it will be a location that captures the vibrant and diverse spirit of San Jose, United States. Nestled amidst the city's bustling life, the venue will be easily accessible and secure, providing a comfortable space for all attendees. As for your culinary needs, San Jose is teeming with Indian restaurants that will satiate your appetite before or after the concert. Parking availability will be communicated in due course.
Grab Your Tickets Today!
Ensure your presence at this spectacular event by securing your tickets now. Choose from the Shadaj (Sa) ticket priced at $60, Rishabh (Re) ticket for $50, or the Gandhar (Ga) ticket for a modest $40. Each ticket tier has been carefully priced to offer you an unforgettable experience. Embrace the spirit of Diwali with an unforgettable musical morning.
